findings.title: Website names bypass anonymous-user field restrictions
findings.description:
`website_name` is not included in `untrusted_attributes`, so it bypasses the restriction that hides TL0 users’ websites from anonymous viewers. It reads the underlying profile website directly and can disclose its hostname—and its path for matching domains—even when `website` is omitted.

Additionally, `include_website_name` lacks the `?` suffix used by serializer inclusion predicates, so it does not provide the intended inclusion guard.

Add `website_name` to `untrusted_attributes` and remove or correct the predicate without overriding that restriction. Extend the anonymous TL0 serializer test with a populated website and assert that neither website field is serialized.

findings.title: Website labels no longer update when preferences change
findings.description:
The template now displays the server-generated `model.website_name`, but the existing preferences save flow does not refresh it. `User#save` in `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/user.js.es6` applies only `bio_excerpt` from the response. The preferences route also shares the parent user model rather than reloading its details.

Consequently, adding a website leaves it hidden until a reload, while changing an existing website can leave its old hostname displayed beside the new link destination. The removed computed property previously updated when `model.website` changed.

Apply the returned `website_name` after saving, or refresh the user details. Add a client-side test covering website changes without a full reload.
